title: Affine differential sections map is surjective
statement: Under the hypotheses of the affine differential sections map, any compatible linear map is surjective.

proof.text: Use the affine-chart derivation compatibility to obtain the explicitly determined comparison T and its action on d. Define the transport from sections of the restricted sheaf back to U using restrictAppIso and restriction across the equality of the chart image and U. The transport is linear by restrictAppIso_fromSpec_smul, Scheme.Modules.map_smul and functoriality.

Compose the spectrum sections map, the inverse of T on sections, and this linear transport. relativeDifferentialsSpecΓHom_d, chart compatibility, ΓSpecIso_inv_map_appIso_inv and naturality show that it sends D(a) to d(a). The compatibility assumption he and KaehlerDifferential.ext identify it with e.

For a section y on U, restrict it to the chart image and apply restrictAppIso.inv. Lift along moduleSpecΓFunctor.map T.inv, then along relativeDifferentialsSpecΓHom; both are isomorphisms and hence surjective. The two restriction maps between U and the chart image compose to identity. Substitution into the established factorization gives e(x)=y.

proof_origin.note: Explicit affine-chart transport and universal derivation extensionality; only chart derivation compatibility is split off. No unit-level route change.
